questions.question: Verify the full dates of both All-Russian congresses of mathematics teachers and Popruzhenko’s roles; the source text gives St Petersburg in 1911 and Moscow in 1913.

localizations.source: Verify the full dates of both All-Russian congresses of mathematics teachers and Popruzhenko’s roles; the source text gives St Petersburg in 1911 and Moscow in 1913.
localizations.ru: Сверить полные даты обоих Всероссийских съездов преподавателей математики и роли Попруженко; в исходном тексте указаны Петербург 1911 года и Москва 1913 года.

questions.resolution: Clarified the congress dates and Popruzhenko’s roles: 27 December 1911–3 January 1912, deputy chair of the First Congress organizing committee; 27 December 1913–3 January 1914, chairman of the Second Congress.

questions.question: Clarify the claim that Elements of Analysis was the first Russian secondary-school textbook on the subject and verify the 1936 and 1939 Soviet problem-book editions, including posthumous editors if credited.

localizations.source: Clarify the claim that Elements of Analysis was the first Russian secondary-school textbook on the subject and verify the 1936 and 1939 Soviet problem-book editions, including posthumous editors if credited.
localizations.ru: Уточнить приоритет «первый отечественный учебник для средней школы» у «Начал анализа» и выходные данные советских изданий задачника 1936 и 1939 годов, включая редакторов посмертных изданий, если они указаны.
